steps: 1. Collect the purchase invoice, warranty card, product photo showing the spurious or missing ISI mark/HUID/CRS logo.
2. Open the official BIS CARE Mobile App or visit www.manakonline.in -> 'Complaints' section.
3. Choose complaint type: 'Misuse of ISI Mark', 'Sub-standard Quality Product', 'Fake Hallmark / Missing HUID', or 'Unauthorized Lab'.
4. Enter product details, manufacturer/seller name, location, and upload supporting photos/bills.
5. Receive a unique Complaint ID (e.g. BIS-CMP-2025-XXXX) via SMS & Email for real-time tracking.
6. Designated BIS Enforcement Branch Officer conducts inspection/market raid and draws testing samples.
7. Upon validation of offense under BIS Act 2016, legal prosecution is initiated and consumer is informed of resolution.
general_workflow.estimated_time: Initial acknowledgement within 48 hours | Investigation & Lab testing report in 15 to 30 working days
general_workflow.escalation_contact: Consumer Affairs Department, BIS HQ, 9 Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg, New Delhi 110002 | Toll-Free: 1915 (National Consumer Helpline) / 1800-11-4000 | Email: complaints@bis.gov.in
required_documents: Retail Invoice / Cash Memo with GSTIN
Clear photograph of the product showing markings or defects
Exact address of the shop/dealer where purchased

sample_complaints.subject: Spurious ISI mark on packaged drinking water bottle
sample_complaints.resolution_notes: Sample drawn from retail shop in Noida Sector 18. Sent to Central Lab Ghaziabad for microbiological analysis.

sample_complaints.subject: Jeweller refused to provide HUID code on 22K gold bangle
sample_complaints.resolution_notes: Bhubaneswar Branch Office issued show-cause notice under Section 14 of BIS Act 2016.

sample_complaints.subject: Sub-standard electric iron overheating without thermal cutoff
sample_complaints.resolution_notes: Manufacturer penalized under BIS Act for non-conformance with IS 302. Defective batch recalled from market.
